definitions.explanation: The transfer of heat, electricity, or other forms of energy through a material, or the transfer of a stimulus through nerves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{熱|ねつ}{伝導|でんどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧{伝導|でんどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測定|そくてい}→測定：04398_sokutei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To measure the speed of nerve conduction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{木材|もくざい}→木材：13017_mokuzai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧{伝導|でんどう}{率|りつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}っ{手|て}→取っ手：24070_totte⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Because wood has a low thermal conductivity, it is often used for pot handles.

notes:
A compound of {伝|でん} (to transmit/convey) and {導|どう} (to lead/conduct). Refers to the physical process by which energy passes through a medium. Not to be confused with the homophones ⟦{伝道|でんどう}→伝道：19201_dendou⟧ (religious evangelism), ⟦{殿堂|でんどう}→殿堂：13227_dendou⟧ (hall of fame), or ⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧ (electric-powered).

The related verb {伝導|でんどう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means "to conduct" (energy). The concept is fundamental in physics, appearing in the study of thermal conductivity, electrical conductivity, and nerve signal transmission.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熱|ねつ}{伝導|でんどう}: heat conduction; thermal conduction
- ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧{伝導|でんどう}: nerve conduction
- {伝導|でんどう}{率|りつ}: conductivity rate
- {伝導|でんどう}⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧: conductor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{電導|でんどう}→電導：26620_dendou⟧: electrical conduction (specifically electrical)
- {対流|たいりゅう}: convection (heat transfer through fluid movement)
- ⟦{放射|ほうしゃ}→放射：16334_housha⟧: radiation (heat transfer through electromagnetic waves)
